column1: # The world each recorded run starts from. Everything not listed is air; the
# caller's own work (a placement, a break) is in region_tick_actions.tsv, since
# a scene can serve more than one run. `rx`/`rz` are the region that owns the
# cell under this port's own grid (`chunks_per_region` from the meta header's
# constants: two chunks a side, so a region spans 32 blocks), which is what
# makes the partition in the traces readable without recomputing it. The leaf
# distances are the settled fixed point of `LeavesBlock.updateDistance` over the
# scene, so a run's writes are the change and not the scene's own
